panels.title: Estate
panels.description: 2 hosts · 3 pools · 6 cluster nodes · 7 guests outside the cluster. CPU and memory from node-exporter, pods running and Ready from kube-state-metrics. The placement is the pools' (0xc0.cc/pool); the guests outside the cluster report nothing here.

text.fixed: Layer 2 only for the zones; no Longhorn replicas here.

panels.title: Traffic
panels.description: Requests over the range, from where they came in to the backend that answered. Public (blue) is the public tunnel, Traefik's websecure entrypoint; WARP (amber) is the internal entrypoint, reached over WARP only. Six backends per entry, the rest summed as other.

panels.title: Edge
panels.description: Cloudflare's edge, every zone (README, Cloudflare; the Adaptive datasets are sampled). Requests per hour: what reached the edge against what reached the origin, Traefik's websecure entrypoint; the gap is what the edge answered itself (cache, redirects, blocks), and what came over WARP to a public name counts at the origin alone. 5xx at the edge: answers of 500 or more, the origin's and Cloudflare's own. WAF blocked: firewall events that blocked or challenged the request. Top countries: shares of every request. Tunnels: each cloudflared connector's connections to the edge, of four, and whether its target answers.

panels.title: Log pulse
panels.description: Log lines per interval, every service, by the level Loki detected. Each row is shaded on its own counts: the brighter the cell, the more lines of that level. Loki reads every line in the range for this, with no results cache, so a range of a day or more takes several seconds to draw.

panels.title: Latest errors · 6 h
panels.description: The last 200 lines at error and above in the last 6 hours, whatever the board's range, every service, grouped by service and message: how many of them each message has, and when the last one came. The message alone, from a JSON or logfmt line's message field, or the line itself without klog's file and line prefix. One log query, grouped here: a metric query grouped by message passes Loki's 500-series limit over a day. Fixed at 6 h: over 24 h the query took about 40 s and once hit Grafana's 30 s timeout.

targets.expr:
# Strapi logs its graceful shutdown, "received SIGTERM, exiting", at error on every rollout.
{service_name=~".+"} | detected_level=~"(?i)(error|err|fatal|critical|crit|panic)" != "received SIGTERM, exiting" | json m_message="message", m_msg="msg", m_body="body" | logfmt m_msg="msg" | drop __error__, __error_details__ | line_format `{{ trunc 140 (regexReplaceAll "^[IWEF][0-9]{4} [0-9:.]+ +[0-9]+ [^ ]+:[0-9]+[]] " (default (default (default __line__ .m_body) .m_msg) .m_message) "") }}`
